name: bandwagon-functions
description: Cloud Functions for Bandwagon: rollups, sleep evaluation, invites and membership.

scripts.test:rules: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --config functions/test/emulators.json --only firestore --project demo-bandwagon-test "tsx --test functions/test/rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:groups: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --config functions/test/emulators.json --only firestore,auth --project demo-bandwagon-test "tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 functions/test/groups.test.ts"
scripts.serve: npm run build && cd .. && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions,storage --project bandwagon-dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd .. && firebase deploy --only functions
